extraction.Name: Jennie Louise Brown—nee Williams
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area implied)
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: she never sold her place for any debts incurred by herself prior to receiving the patent in fee; in April, 1920, she sold this allotment to Bert McCollister, of Martin, South Dakota, for $2000.00 cash
extraction.Buyer: Bert McCollister, of Martin, South Dakota, for $2000.00 cash
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband, who has good health, supports her and the children, he being a farmer, this being his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is good; mother of two small children who have good health; husband is a farmer; she considers she received a good price for the land; her mother promised to reimburse her by deeding her a quarter of the mother's land but never did; sold land to get money for sick brother who needed to be taken to a good hospital; allotment described as SE¼, Sec. 26, T. 37N., R. 37W., of the 6th P.M., in South Dakota, 160 acres; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document no. 4574; subscribed and sworn April 22, 1929
